limits: Linux WebKit is not real-device Safari/iOS certification.
PDF to Word exports editable text with detected headings/tables/images, not exact layout/charts.
Technical lab SEO does not guarantee indexing/rank/AI inclusion.
Original application source remains private/restricted; upstream rights preserved.

Firefox cases ran in a combined Firefox+WebKit session; WebKit cases ran as split sessions (search/pipelines, interface, tools, one isolation retry) on a memory-limited lab machine; every case passed unmodified.
One Firefox cancellation check releases its test-only network hold after the cancelled state is asserted so the worker-settling assertion measures the app rather than the hold.
scope: Dated published functional baseline, not an every-file or security certification.
